newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cold Metal Products cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cold Metal Products cut to hold.

text.p: McDonald & Co Securities said Monday it lowered its rating on Cold Metal Products Inc to hold from buy and reduced its fiscal year 1998 earnings estimate to $0.45 a share from $0.60. That compares to earnings of $0.48 a share reported in fiscal 1997, which ended in March, McDonald & Co said.

-- Cold Metal shares "continue to represent solid value, but continuing delays in bringing on new capacity concurrent with recent weakness in base businesses form the basis of our rating change," McDonald & Co said in a research report.

-- Ramp up of the metals and mining company's new wide strip mill has continued to emerge more slowly than McDonald & Co had expected, McDonald & Co said. "While performance problems related to material handling have been mostly resolved, loading the mill with profitable business has remained elusive thus far," McDonald & Co said.
-- Cold Metals shares were up 1/16 at 5-11/16 Monday.
